priorityList: Summon Felguard and cast Power Siphon before combat begins.
Use Potion, Power Infusion, and Combat Racials while Demonic Tyrant is active.
Use on-use Trinkets during Demonic Tyrant or when Tyrant is on cooldown for more than 20 seconds.
Cast Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer stacks of Demonic Core.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan immediately if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Grimoire: Felguard (or Grimoire: Imp Lord) and Summon Doomguard on cooldown.
Cast Call Dreadstalkers on cooldown; if talented into Reign of Tyranny, avoid casting if Tyrant is 12-20 seconds from being ready.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant once you have reached 5 Soul Shards.
Cast Ruination whenever the proc is available.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if you have 5 Soul Shards, or if you have 3+ Soul Shards and Tyrant is more than 5 seconds from being ready.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have a Demonic Core proc and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
If talented into Doom, prioritize casting Demonbolt on targets that do not currently have the Doom debuff.
Cast Shadow Bolt as your primary filler to generate Soul Shards when no other actions are available.
